obverse.description: Christ standing facing on footstool, wearing nimbus and holding Gospels, IC XC across fields.

reverse.description: Eudocia on left, wearing loros with kite-shaped lower panel and crown with cross and pendilia, Constantine on right, wearing loros and crown with cross and pendilia, both standing facing, holding labarum with cross-piece on shaft between them, standing on base and three steps, each places one hand on heart.
